title: Stir Fried Leek Pasta
description: A simple Chinese-inspired dish made with stir-fried leeks and pasta. This recipe is quick to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced leeks and stir-fry until they are tender and lightly browned.
Add the cooked pasta, soy sauce, and chopped green onions to the skillet.
Stir-fry everything together for about 2 minutes, until the pasta is well coated with the sauce.
